name: Aloo Sev
ingredients_raw: EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (CONTAINS ONE OR MORE OF THE FOLLOWINGS: PALMOLEIN, RICE BRAN, CORN, COTTONSEED), CHICKPEA FLOUR, POTATO FLAKES (21%), **SEASONING MALTODEXTRIN, EDIBLE COMMON SALT, SPICES & CONDIMENTS (DRY MANGO, CUMIN, FENNEL, CHILLI, CORIANDER, CLOVE, TURMERIC, PEPPER, CARDAMOM, GINGER), DEHYDRATED VEGETABLE POWDER (MINT 0.2%, GARLIC, TAMARIND), FLAVOUR (NATURAL& NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES), ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS 330, INS 296), FLAVOUR ENHANCER (INS 635), ANTICAKING AGENT (INS 551, INS 341 (1), RICE FLOUR, AS FLAVOURING & SEASONING AGENT NAMKEEN READY-TO-EAT SAVOURIES | PROPRIETARY FOOD INDIAN SNACKS & SAVOURIES PRODUCT OF INDIA
